Voter Frustration Mounts Over Both Parties As Immigration Hardens, Trump Approval Holds Flat

President Donald J. Trump [...] President Donald Trump’s job approval rating remains 11 points underwater heading into the final stretch before the November elections, with 43% of voters approving of his performance and 54% disapproving, according to new Morning Consult polling data.

The numbers reflect the steady band the president has occupied throughout the summer, but underlying intensity points to an engagement gap between the two major parties.
